rules: recovered qosa-1.0.0; primary 3 players x 9 stones + 1 stock
scope: deal-generation validation only; branch, turn, block, match scoring and strategy outcomes are not simulated

test.method: fixed deterministic seed range; exact hypergeometric reference probabilities; 7-sigma binomial smoke bands plus one-count slack

finding: No gross seat/tile-position or double-count distribution anomaly detected in the 50,000-seed smoke test. Conditional on 1-1 being in a 9-tile hand, that pre-opening hand has 2 or 3 doubles with exact probability 68.09%; this is a deal-composition baseline, not a tactic.
limitations: A deterministic finite-seed smoke test is not proof of PRNG uniformity.
The starter double-count statistic is before the mandatory opening draw and follow-up.
The first-round 1-1-in-stock redeal rule is not simulated here.
No game rounds, strategies, block rules, match scoring, or tactical outcomes were measured.
Unique allocations across seeds were not deduplicated.
exactNextAction: Run this committed test and the block/branch Node regressions in a clean checkout when GitHub DNS is available; then extend deal invariants to the initializer's mandatory 1-1 draw/follow-up without treating its canonical side as a physical preference.
